1.0 Executive Summary - Objective and Ba.Customer Objective: [Client]'s objective is to carry out a modernization program for its Enterprise Data Warehouse ("EDW") ecosystem, which is primarily based on an on-premises Teradata technology platform, and to complete a migration from a legacy on-premises solution to a next-generation cloud-based technology within Google Cloud Platform ("GCP").
1.0 Executive Summary - Objective and Ba.Primary Goal: The primary goal of this modernization program is to establish a comprehensive end-to-end ("E2E") data management capability aimed at the enhancement of a data ecosystem built over considerable time, and currently serving multiple critical functions, such as Marketing, Sales Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Executive Reporting.
1.0 Executive Summary - Objective and Ba.Program Components: The Program will involve the modernization of the EDW platform (currently based on Teradata technology) encompassing the existing data pipelines, the migration to GCP including all historical data (excluding [Internal] datasets), the configuration and set up of products and services in the GCP environment, the identification of acceptable quality control limits for the identified critical data elements for data quality and governance, real-time availability of the data for business users, the provision of a scalable platform for [Client] business users and near real-time insights to lead to improved business outcomes.
1.0 Executive Summary - Objective and Ba.Proposed Solution: [Vendor] proposes to provide its migration services using its automated migration tools, including but not limited to (e.g., [Discovery Tool], [Conversion Tool], and [Validation Tool]) technology and subject matter experts to help [Client] achieve its stated business objectives.
